REQUIREMENTS 3.1 Welding and welder qualifications shall be in accordance with AWS D1.1 for steel, AWS D1.2 or MIL-W-22248,Class 4 for aluminum, AWS D1.3 for sheet steel and AWS D1.6 for stainless steel. Proper controls shall be used to prevent melt through or burn through. For aluminum, filler for welding 6061 alloy shall be 4043: filler for welding 5000 series alloys to themselves or to 6061 shall be 5356 or 5556. In addition,welding and weld inspection shall include: (1) Visual inspection shall include 5X (5power) magnification when a suspect condition is to be examined beyond the capability of normal vision. (2) Critical and major welds may be subjected to further non destructive testing (such as dye penetrant inspection)as prescribed by the buying activity. (3) Proper documentation shall be available for review by Government personnel. 3.2 WORK INSTRUCTIONS. Work instructions shall be posted at theoperator's work station giving procedures to control the welding process, i.e., filler material, weld size, electrical and gas characteristics, including flow rate. 3.3 MATERIALS AND MATERIALS CONTROL. The quality program shall assure that the materials used in fabrication or processing, i.e., base metals and weld filler material, be inspected and conform to the applicable physical, chemical and other technical requirements (supplier's certification is sufficient). 3.4 CONTROLS. Weld filler materials shall be clearly identified and segregated from each other both when in storage and at the work station. Work station environment shall be controlled to prevent conditions adverse to proper gas shielding. 3.5 CLEANING. Parts to be welded shall be cleaned to remove surface soils such as oils, waxes, grease, inks, etc. except that uninhibited alkaline solutions such as sodium hydroxide shall NOT be used. 3.6 DEOXIDIZING. The cleaned parts shall be chemically deoxidized NO MORE THAN 10 DAYS PRIOR TO WELDING to remove thick surface oxide films. (If the material or work is exposed to an outdoor environment, this time limit shall be reduced to a maximum of 3 days, to account for atmospheric effects.) Mechanical cleaning methods shall be applied just prior to the actual start of welding, to remove any reoxidation or residual thin oxide films. 3.6.1 CHEMICAL TREATMENT. An acid deoxidizing treatment shall be applied by either immersion or brushing/wiping. Deoxidizers acceptable for use shall include nitric acid, sulfuric chromic, phosphoric chromic, or equivalent solutions. Sodium hydroxide solutions shall not be used. Care shall be taken to assure 100% solution coverage of the area to be welded. To allow an adequately sized deoxidized area for good welding, the solution shall be applied to an area extending at least 2 inches from the weld site, or ending at any closer adjacent edge. 3.6.2 MECHANICAL MEANS. Immediately prior to welding, mechanical cleaning methods shall be applied to the weld areas previously chemically treated to assure removal of residual or reformed oxides, if any. Acceptable methods of mechanical cleaning include stainless steel wire brushing, scraping, filing, or sanding. However, abrasives containing iron and its oxides, steel wool and wire, and copper alloy based wire, which may become embedded with galvanically active metals and accelerate corrosion of aluminum alloys shall NOT be used. Mechanical methods shall be vigorous enough to adequately remove any residual oxide films, but gentle enough to avoid forming an excessively rough surface in the comparatively soft metal underneath. 4. description: Combined Synopsis/Solicitation Notice Combined Synopsis/Solicitation Notice Combined Synopsis/Solicitation Notice REQUEST FOR SF 330 36C25227Q0013 Project 578-27-003: Renovate A Section 1st Floor Bldg. 1 (AE) Design/Engineering Services SF-330 Package Due: October 30, 2026, at 1:00 p.m. CST (see details below) Points of Contact: Donita.Grace@va.gov INTRODUCTION: THIS IS A TOTAL 100% SERVICE-DISABLED VETERAN-OWNED SMALL BUSINESS (SDVOSB) SET-ASIDE in accordance with Public Law 109-461. This is a Request for SF330s for Architect/Engineer (A/E) Design Services for Project Number 578-27-003: Renovate A Section 1st Floor Bldg. 1 (AE) at the Edward J. Hines VA Hospital in Hines, IL. THIS ANNOUNCEMENT IS NOT A REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL. NO SOLICITATION PACKAGE WILL BE ISSUED via SAM.gov. A request for proposal will be issued directly to the top-rated firm for which negotiations will commence in accordance with FAR part 36. The anticipated A/E design services, to be awarded, will be procured in accordance with the Selection of Architects and Engineers Act (Public Law 92- 582), FAR Part 36.6 and VA Acquisition Regulation 836.6. Period of Performance: 449 Calendar Days Contract Type: Firm-Fixed-Price Estimated Magnitude of Construction: Between $10,000,000 and $20,000,000 NAICS Code: 541310 Size Standard: $12.5 Million SBA & SAM : in accordance with VAAR 819.7003, at the time of SF330 submission and prior to award of any contract, the offeror must represent to the contracting officer that it is a (1) SDVOSB eligible firm; (2) Small business concern under the North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code assigned to the acquisition; and (3) SDVOSB listed as verified in SBA at: https://veterans.certify.sba.gov/ Additionally, all eligible firms must be registered and current in the System for Award Management (SAM) database to be evaluated and eligible for contract award. If the firm is not registered in SAM, you may register online at https://www.sam.gov. 1. PURPOSE: This Source Selection Plan (SSP) outlines the procedures that will be used to solicit architectural and engineering (AE) design services for Project 578-27-003 Renovate A Section on First Floor of Building 1. The goal of this project is to provide complete AE design services to renovate section A of the 1st floor of building 1. 2. ACQUISISTION DESCRIPTION: 2.1: RFI: A Request for Information shall be published to https://sam.gov whereby interested architect-engineering companies shall submit an SF330 package. This competitive procurement shall utilize a best value trade-off source selection process identified in FAR 15. 2.1.a: Source Selection Evaluation Board (SSEB): For the purpose of this acquisition, the SSEB will be same as the Technical Evaluation Board (TEB). 2.1.b: Below are the individual (TEB) evaluation criteria and ratings for the SF330s, listed in descending order of importance. FACTOR 1: SPECIALIZED EXPERIENCE AND TECHNICAL COMPETENCE (30 Maximum Points) Subfactor 1A: Specialized Experience (15 Points). Subfactor 1B: Additional Experience (10 points). Subfactor 1C: Technical Competence (5 points). The A/E Firm shall demonstrate its specialized experience and technical competence in the design and construction period services for projects of similar size and complexity. Specialized project experience should include design of renovations to existing hospitals, renovations to buildings constructed prior to 1970 w/space constraints, design of Pathology Suites, and HVAC upgrades to existing hospitals. Additional experience includes mechanical, electrical, and structural engineering, architecture, interior design and finishes, physical security upgrades, building management systems/building automation systems (BMS/BAS), Computer-Aided Design and Drafting (CADD), critical path scheduling, fire protection, construction infection control protocols, design and installation of biological refrigeration and preservation systems, design and installation of vacuum tube transport systems, and project phasing and coordination in an active hospital setting. Offeror shall provide a minimum of three (3), and no more than five (5) recent and relevant Government and private experience projects similar in size, scope, and complexity, and experience with the type of projects/competence above. Relevant is defined as those task requirements identified in the Statement of Work. Recent is defined as services provided within the past seven (7) years with at least 50% of the Construction completed. At a minimum, include the following for each submitted project (if applicable): Project title, location, contract number, and detailed narrative describing the scope of services provided including the type of work performed by the offeror and its role in the project i.e., prime contract, Teaming Partner, or subcontractor. Project Owner, owner s point of contact including telephone number and email address. Services & Deliverables provided under the contract/task order Period of Performance, including start and completion dates for design and construction if applicable. Estimated cost of construction based on AE s design Final construction cost (or projected final construction cost if still underway) The percentage of total cost resulting from changes due to AE omissions. To demonstrate technical competence, the offeror shall include narratives of how the firm addresses each of the following topics. Simply restating this list will not be sufficient. The management approach The coordination of disciplines and subcontractors Quality control procedures Familiarity with VA Design Guides/Manuals, Master Specifications and other applicable standards. FACTOR 2: PROFESSIONAL QUALIFICATIONS (20 Maximum Points) Subfactor 2A: Key Positions (15 Points). Subfactor 2B: SDVOSB Compliance (5 Points). The architects and engineers on the firm s staff representing the project or signing/stamping drawings in each discipline must possess a minimum of five (5) years of experience and are required to be licensed, registered, or certified by a U.S. state, the District of Columbia, or a U.S. territory. Provide professional license jurisdiction of issue and license numbers and/or proof of licensure. A resume for each of these key positions must be provided, corresponding with the title matching the disciplines listed for the project. At a minimum, the offeror must describe the professional qualifications and specific experience in the required disciplines within the past five (5) years. Key positions and disciplines required for this project include, but are not limited to: Project Manager Architect Mechanical Engineer Electrical Engineer Plumbing Engineer Structural Engineer Interior Designer The evaluation will consider education, certifications, training, registration, overall and relevant experience and longevity with the firm. Offer must include the following statement of SDVOSB compliance when submitting the personnel proposed to perform the work under this requirement: I [signatory authority] ______________________, [company] _____________________; certify that the team proposed to perform under this requirement demonstrates the capability of 50% SDVOSB performance in compliance of 48 CFR 852.219-10. FACTOR 3: PAST PERFORMANCE (20 Maximum Points) Subfactor 3A: Past Performance of projects identified in FACTOR 1. (15 Points). Subfactor 3B: Average Past Performance of all projects (5 Points). Provide CPARS data for all projects identified in FACTOR 1. For any project that does NOT have CPARS data available, a Past Performance Questionnaire (PPQ) is required to be submitted with the SF330. Please utilize the attached PPQ document. CPARS data and PPQs will not be included in the page count. All projects provided in the SF330 must be completed by the office/ branch/ individual team member performing the work under this contract. description: Public Services and Procurement Canada (PSPC) is asking interested parties to provide information for a potential lease of space that meets the following criteria: Section A: Lease Components • a lease term of approximately 10 years, commencing on or about October 1, 2029, with a right of early termination anytime on or after October 1, 2037, provided written notice is given at least 12 months prior; • approximately 513.0 usable square metres (um2) of contiguous office space, and one (1) outdoor energized parking space; • the proposed space must be available approximately 48 weeks prior to the above-noted lease commencement date so all space(s) may be prepared for occupancy; • the proposed space should satisfy or be capable of satisfying the following criteria: 1. the proposed space should be within an office or commercial type building; buildings situated within heavy or medium industrial zoning and industrial type buildings with warehouse or manufacturing space will not be considered. title: Y--NGWSP Cutter Lateral Reach 21 Booster Plant
description: Pre-Solicitation Notice: NGWSP Cutter Lateral Reach 21 Booster Plant PURPOSE: The U.S. Bureau of Reclamation, Upper Colorado Basin Region, Four Corners Construction Office (FCCO), is issuing this pre-solicitation notice for a contemplated construction project titled: Navajo Gallup Water Supply Project (NGWSP) Cutter Lateral Reach 21 Booster Plant. This requirement is being procured in accordance with Part 14 of the Federal Acquisition Regulations (FAR) with a set-aside for small businesses. The Bureau of Reclamation intends to issue a competitive solicitation for this requirement. Based on market research it was determined that there were a sufficient number of qualified small businesses with sufficient bonding capacity to perform as the prime contractor on this project, and as such, it is anticipated to be set-aside for small businesses. PROJECT DESCRIPTION: The Navajo Gallup Water Supply Project (NGWSP) is a major infrastructure project that once constructed, will convey a reliable municipal and industrial water supply from the San Juan River to the eastern section of the Navajo Nation, southwestern portion of the Jicarilla Apache Nation, and the city of Gallup, New Mexico via approximately 280 miles of pipeline, several pumping plants, and two water treatment plants. The principal components of work for the Cutter Lateral Reach 21 Booster Plant include, but are not limited to, the following: 1. Pre-engineered concrete booster pump station, concrete foundation pad, pipe encasement, yard pipe, fencing, electrical equipment, gravel surfacing, and pipe connections. 2. Installation of secondary regulation tank at Regulation Tank No. 3 site, foundation, electrical equipment, yard pipe, and pipe connections. 3. Erosion and scour restoration/prevention: a. Includes a retaining wall, swale, runoff channel, and site regrading. 4. Reinstallation of gravel surfacing at Regulation Tank No. 3 site. 5. Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) equipment and radio communications system. LOCATION OF THE WORK: The NGWSP Cutter Lateral Reach 21 booster plant is located approximately 26 miles South of Bloomfield, NM off County Road 7575 near U.S. Highway 550, at the base of Huerfano Mesa in San Juan County, New Mexico. NAICS AND SIZE STANDARD: The NAICS code for this project is 237110 (Water and Sewer Line and Related Structures Construction) with a small business size standard of $45.0 million. COMPETITION: Solicitation 140R4026B0003 is anticipated to be conducted as a small business set-aside. The project specifications and project location will be defined in the solicitation document. The solicitation will require a bid guarantee of at least 20% of the bid price. The Contract will require payment and performance bonds for 100% of the contract price. Offerors must have sufficient bonding capacity. DISCLOSURE OF THE MAGNITUDE OF THE CONSTRUCTION PROJECT: The magnitude of this project is between $10,000,000 and $25,000,000. SOLICITATION RELEASE DATE: All responsible sources may submit a proposal which shall be considered by the agency. A free, electronic copy of the solicitation will be available on APPROXIMATELY November 2, 2026, at https://www.sam.gov/. Simply type in solicitation number "140R4026B0003" in the Keyword / Solicitation # field. A draft solicitation for comment has been attached to this announcement. The purpose of the draft solicitation is for comments only. When comments are received and incorporated, the solicitation will be posted requesting the submission of proposals. This project will follow a best-value procurement process under Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) Part 14. Questions and comments must be submitted in writing by e-mail to Philoma Singer at philoma_singer@ios.doi.gov and Tyler Spencer, at tyler_spencer@ios.doi.gov. SYSTEM FOR AWARD MANAGEMENT (SAM, www.sam.gov): The System for Award Management (SAM) is a recently implemented Federal Government owned-and-operated FREE web site that consolidates the capabilities in Central Contractor Registration (CCR)/Federal Register (FedReg), Online Representations and Certifications Application (ORCA), and Excluded Parties List System (EPLS). Offerors must be successfully registered in SAM in order to be considered for a government contract award. If you had an active record in CCR, you have an active record in SAM. SITE VISIT: The Government intends to conduct a site visit for highly interested vendors AROUND November 12, 2026. Information regarding the site visit will be in Section L of the solicitation once released. POINT-OF-CONTACT FOR QUESTIONS: The Contract Specialist for this solicitation is Philoma Singer at philoma_singer@ios.doi.gov. The Contracting Officer for this solicitation is Tyler Spencer, tyler_spencer@ios.doi.gov. Any communication regarding this procurement must be made in writing and forwarded via email and must identify the solicitation number, company name, address, email address, phone number including area code, and point of contact. Emails shall be addressed to the Contract Specialist and cc the Contracting Officer. NOTE: THIS IS NOT A REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL (SOLICITATION), AN INVITATION FOR BID (IFB), NOR IS IT A REQUEST FOR QUOTATION (RFQ). It is not to be construed as a commitment by the requesting party to issue a solicitation or ultimately award a contract. Responses will not be considered as proposals, bids, or quotes. No award will be made as a result of this Notice. The Government will NOT be responsible for any costs incurred by interested parties in responding to this Notice. This FedBizOps Notice is strictly for compliance with FAR Subpart 5.2. As a result of this Notice, the Government may issue a competitive solicitation; however, should such requirements materialize, no basis for claims against the Government shall arise as a result of a response to the Notice (e.g. use of such information as either part of its evaluation process or in developing specifications for any subsequent requirement). title: Preventative Maintenance and Repair of Heavy Equipment for the Fort Mifflin Project Office
description: The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Philadelphia District, intends to award a Firm-Fixed Price, Indefinite Delivery Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) Single Award Task Order Contract (SATOC) for Preventative Maintenance and Repair of Heavy Equipment for the Fort Mifflin Project Office within the USACE Philadelphia (NAP) District area of responsibility in accordance with the attached Performance Work Statement (PWS). The Contractor is responsible for scheduling work in accordance with the requirements of task order issued and during regular business hours when scheduling on site work. The site conducts regular business from 7:00am to 3:00pm, Monday through Friday, except for federal holidays. All work is to be performed during these regular business hours. Any hours to be worked outside of the regular business hours shall be coordinated with the COR. The contractor shall provide all personnel, equipment, supplies, facilities, transportation, tools, materials, supervision, and other items and non-personal services necessary to perform preventative maintenance and repair of heavy equipment for the Fort Mifflin Project Office as defined in this Performance Work Statement except for those items specified as government furnished property and services. The contractor shall perform to the standards in this contract. The Fort Mifflin Project Office is responsible for the construction of the district�s disposal areas located along the Delaware River. Our mission supports the deepening and the maintenance dredging of the Delaware River and Wilmington Harbor. Heavy Equipment is utilized to construct dikes, ditching for drying and other dirt work. Our equipment is currently composed of D6 Dozers, Excavators (tracks and pontoons), dump trucks (articulated). Without equipment to provide the necessary dirt work in these disposals� areas, dredging assignments in the Delaware Harbor could not be accomplished. It is important that dredging and proper disposal activities of dredge materials is accomplished because it directly effects commerce and the safety of vessels transporting commodities and other resources to the ports. See attachment labeled "W912BU26QA024_FMPO Combined Solicitation Synopsis.pdf" with the requirements of this RFQ and other attachments required for informational and submission purposes.

description: SOLICITATION SPE603-26-R-0543 Government-Owned, Contactor-Operated (GOCO) and Contractor-Owned/Contractor-Operated (COCO) fuel services at Marine Corps Air Ground Combat Center 29 Palms, CA Defense Logistics Agency (DLA) - Energy - FESAB is issuing a Request for Proposal (RFP) for Government-Owned, Contractor-Operated (GOCO) and Contractor Owned, Contractor-Operated (COCO) Fuel Storage, Operations, and Distribution services at Marine Corps Air Ground Combat Center (MCAGCC) 29 Palms, CA. The Contractor will be responsible for the management, operation, maintenance, product quality surveillance, inventory control and accounting, security, safety, and environmental protection of the Marine Corps GOCO and COCO fuel facilities. The Contractor will ensure safe, accurate, and timely handling, quality control, and accountability of all Defense Wide Working Capital Fund (DWWCF)-owned petroleum products under their control. The Contractor will perform required maintenance to ensure facilities, associated systems, vehicles, and equipment remain operational to meet the base mission. The Contractor will comply with environmental protection, safety, and security directives. The Contractor will conduct required training to ensure personnel are fully qualified to perform Performance Work Statement (PWS) tasks. The contractor must receive, maintain, store, sample and test, internal transfer, and issue petroleum products. The contractor must be responsible for all fuel-servicing operations and safeguarding facilities, equipment, and fuel products under its control during normal and adverse conditions. The contractor must track aviation fuels inventories and order products as needed to meet DLA Energy Accounting Policies and maintain levels to ensure uninterrupted service. This procurement is 100% set aside for Service-Disabled Veteran Owned Business (SDVOSB) under NAICS code 493190 (Other Warehouse and Storage). The Government anticipates awarding a firm fixed-price contract. The Period of Performance (PoP) will be from March 15, 2028 � September 14, 2031 (COCO PoP 3.5-yearbase), September 15, 2028 � September 14, 2031 (GOCO PoP 3-year base), four, five-year option periods from September 15, 2031 � September 14, 2036 (1st Option); September 15,2036 � September 14, 2041 (2nd Option); September 15, 2041 � September 14, 2046 (3rdOption); September 15, 2046 � September 14, 2051 (4th Option), one, 4.5-year option period from September 15, 2051 - March 14, 2056 (5th Option); and an option to extend the contract not to exceed six (6) months from March 15, 2056 through September 14, 2056. title: Data at Rest (DaR) - 400 Obsolescence Resolution
description: OBJECTIVE: The USAF E-3G AWACS provides worldwide response to situations requiring immediate and continuous on-scene command, control, and battle management using embedded real-time surveillance to support employment of U.S. and allied combat forces. The E-3G consists of the air vehicle, sensor systems, and computing and communications equipment. The current USAF E-3G operational fleet consists of 15 operational aircraft. The E-3G DAR-400 (part numbers 63-2824652-01 through -03) is a mission critical asset and is in critical need of obsolescence resolution to prevent mission impact. Since the DAR-400 contains encrypted MCS, MSS, IPEC and GS data, a failure would directly impact operations and data security. General Dynamics Mission Systems (GDMS) has notified us that the DAR-400 will not be able to support or upgrade to changing NSA requirements. SCOPE: To execute the installation and integration of the obsolescence resolution for the mission-critical E-3G DAR-400 to prevent mission impact. The provided Government-owned KG-204 based solution is compliant with current DoD and NSA mandates to replace the legacy DAR-400 equipment. REQUEST FOR INFORMATION DETAILS: 1. AFLCMC/WIW is requesting information from industry as part of market research to determine interest level and size of qualified vendors. 2. THIS IS A SOURCES SOUGHT ONLY. It is not a Request for Proposal, a Request for Quotation, an Invitation for Bid, a solicitation, or an indication the US Air Force (AF) or AFLCMC/WIW will contract for the items contained in the sources sought. AFLCMC/WIW will not pay respondents for information provided in response to the sources sought. 3. The Government is requesting information from vendors of all business sizes including socioeconomic programs such as 8(a), Historically Underutilized Business Zone (HUBZone), Women Owned Small Business, or Service-Disabled Veteran Owned Small Businesses (SDVOSB) that are interested in performing this requirement. The Government requests interested parties submit a brief description of their company�s business size (i.e., annual revenues and employee size), business status (i.e., 8(a), HUBZone, or SDVOSB, Women Owned Small Business, or small business), and any anticipated teaming arrangements. The Government will use this information in determining its small business set-aside decision. 4. Interested parties should submit a capabilities package, with a cover letter, that is brief and concise yet clearly demonstrates ability to meet the stated requirements with sufficiently qualified personnel. Provide qualification information (type and duration of employee experience relevant to the requirements) and the level of involvement (prime or sub-contractor) and time periods for work on similar projects. The capabilities package should clearly present evidence that the interested party is fully capable of providing the required services and as such may contain any information that the interested party feels relevant. 5. Responses should be submitted electronically, and must be no more than ten single-spaced pages, using 12-point, Times New Roman font, and minimum one-inch margins, in Microsoft Word format. Responses that only provide a company website will not be considered. 6. Responses to the sources sought are requested by 3PM, CDT, 12 October 2026. All responses shall be unclassified and reviewed to ensure consideration. All responses, correspondence, and/or questions related to this matter should be e-mailed to: E-mail: phaedra.prather@us.af.mil Phone: (405) 739-4340 Attachments: DAR 400 Follow On SOW_Sep 2026 DAR Follow-On draft CDRL_DID Package 2026

title: Europe South District Playground Inspection, Maintenance, and Repair
description: The Department of War Education Activity (DoWEA) is one of only two federally operated school systems in the United States. DoWEA plans, directs, coordinates, and manages pre-kindergarten through grade 12 educational programs on behalf of the Department of War (DoW). DoWEA operates approximately 165 brick-and-mortar schools across eight districts located in seven U.S. states, eleven foreign countries, Guam, and Puerto Rico, serving more than 72,000 students worldwide. DoWEA Europe consists of multiple districts encompassing schools, District Superintendent Offices (DSOs), and Student Transportation Offices (STOs) supporting children of active-duty military members and eligible civilian employees. The Contractor shall provide full-service, performance-based playground inspection, preventive maintenance, repair, emergency response, cleaning services for DoWEA facilities located in Europe South Region. For the purposes of this PWS, playgrounds include all playground systems and associated features, whether standalone or co-located, including but not limited to: Playground equipment and structures; Playground surfacing systems; Hard-surface and multi-use play courts; Outdoor recreational and athletic surfaces; and, Perimeter features, furnishings, and appurtenances. The Contractor shall furnish all management, supervision, labor, tools, equipment, materials, transportation, documentation, and incidentals necessary to ensure playgrounds remain safe, serviceable, compliant, and operational throughout the period of performance.

INTRODUCTION: This Sources Sought Notice (SSN) is for market research and information purposes only at this time and shall not be construed as a solicitation or as an obligation on the part of the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA). The Department of Veterans Affairs, Veterans Health Administration (VHA), Program Contracting Activity Central (PCAC) is conducting a market survey and is seeking potential sources for the Electronic Health Record Modernization (EHRM) Infrastructure Upgrades Construction project at the West Haven VA Medical Center (VAMC) located at 950 Campbell Avenue, West Haven CT 06516. INDUSTRY DAY: Please be advised that industry days have been scheduled for October 7, 2026 and October 8, 2026 in conjunction with this SSN. PROJECT DESCRIPTION: The Department of Veteran Affairs is in the process of migrating from its existing Computerized Patient Record System (CPRS) to the new EHRM platform. The scope of this project includes but is not limited to the following: upgrade facility fiber throughout the buildings to each Telecommunications Room (TR), provide a redundant fiber run throughout the facility to each TR, provide redundant fiber mains to the redundant demarcation rooms from the provider point, install data drops, install new electrical outlets throughout the facility, provide additional power in each TR, upgrade facility power distribution as required, upgrade facility HVAC distribution as required, physical security assessment and upgrades, and hazardous material abatement. In addition to ensuring adequate capacity for planned growth and maintenance, this project addresses deficiencies as defined by the PSRDM (Physical Security Design and Resiliency Manual) 2021 VA Standard. The following buildings have been identified as having deficiencies to address: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 11, 11A, 12, 14, 15, 16A, 21, 22, 24, 27, 34, 35, 35A, 36, 36A, 12A, 14A, 15A, 2B, and site. title: Wireless Telecommunications Carriers (except Satellite)
description: The Contractor shall provide reliable, secure, and high-quality commercial cellular telephone services including voice, messaging, and data throughout Jordan and designated roaming countries. Key elements from the 07 October 2026 PWS include: Service Capabilities: Local and international voice calls; SMS and MMS; internet data; call waiting, call forwarding, three-way calling, and voicemail; tethering; automated SMS usage notifications from the service provider. Feature Authorization: Cellular devices shall be explicitly authorized to utilize only those capabilities specified in the assigned service plan. The Contractor shall disable all unauthorized features. Unauthorized access shall result in no additional expense to the U.S. Government. Coverage: Complete 5G cellular service coverage (or then-current commercial standard, whichever is greater) across the Joint Training Center (JTC), Jordan, including all indoor facilities. Reliable connectivity at all U.S. Government facilities in Jordan. Roaming Network: Single total rate applicable to a special calling group that includes Kuwait, Afghanistan, Iraq, Yemen, Egypt, Jordan, United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, Turkey, Oman, Bahrain, Syria, Djibouti, Lebanon, United States of America, Spain, Germany, United Kingdom, and Ireland. Service Plans: Premium-level plans meeting or exceeding unlimited local incoming/outgoing minutes and SMS/MMS; 150 minutes international/roaming; 150 international/roaming SMS/MMS; 18 GB local and Roaming Network data; tethering; voicemail and advanced calling features. Additional Data Packs (2 GB, 30-day expiration, non-auto-refresh) and MiFi Data plans (10 GB base, incremental 2 GB) required. Service Solutions Applicable to All Users: Accounts configured to prevent overages once plan limits are reached (Contracting Officer may set/remove spend limits); unlimited calling group minutes, SMS, and MMS between users on the account; free incoming/outgoing SMS from the service provider; free incoming international calls deducted from local minutes balance (not charged at an increased rate). SIM Management: Ability to activate, change, or disable individual SIM cards within 12 hours of written notification; free SMS usage alerts at 50%, 75%, 95%, and 100% of monthly allotted call, SMS, and data; trio re-pluggable, three-size form-fit, pre-cut SIM cards; rapid replacement/repair/reimbursement for defective SIMs. Technical & On-Site Support: 24/7/365 technical support with English-language industry-standard trouble tracking; on-site hardware/software support personnel available to arrive within 24 hours of notification; fluent in English including technical terminology; emergency repair response within 24 hours. Network Performance Standards: Network availability ? 99.9% (measured monthly); call setup success rate ? 98%; dropped call rate ? 2%; excellent voice quality with minimal static, echo, or distortion; compliance with primary Quality of Service (QoS) performance obligations in the Contractor�s telecommunications license; service (technology, speed, availability) equivalent to that provided to the Contractor�s commercial customers. Network Survivability and Recovery: Working system of network survivability for emergencies and serious disasters; recovery plan addressing network congestion or partial destruction; online tool for assignment of short numbers, call screening rules, and batch provisioning of directory for Business Group members. Mass Notification: Capability to notify all users on the account via SMS within sixty (60) seconds of initiation. Infrastructure & Maintenance: Capability to enhance coverage via towers, antennas, Cellular-On-Wheels (COWs), repeaters, or in-building solutions at no additional cost to the Government; maintain and refuel fixed and mobile cellular towers; coordinate scheduled maintenance at least seven (7) days in advance. Administrative: WAWF invoicing; online account management portal for the Contracting Officer and authorized representatives; mid-cycle plan changes applied the day of request with prorated charges only (no overlap or double billing); JCCS registration and Combating Trafficking in Persons (CTIP) plan requirements. Note: The full Performance Work Statement (PWS) dated 07 October 2026 will be provided upon request to interested parties that submit a capability statement. The PWS is the authoritative requirements document.

title: Data at Rest (DaR) - 400 Obsolescence Resolution
description: OBJECTIVE: The USAF E-3G AWACS provides worldwide response to situations requiring immediate and continuous on-scene command, control, and battle management using embedded real-time surveillance to support employment of U.S. and allied combat forces. The E-3G consists of the air vehicle, sensor systems, and computing and communications equipment. The current USAF E-3G operational fleet consists of 15 operational aircraft. The E-3G DAR-400 (part numbers 63-2824652-01 through -03) is a mission critical asset and is in critical need of obsolescence resolution to prevent mission impact. Since the DAR-400 contains encrypted MCS, MSS, IPEC and GS data, a failure would directly impact operations and data security. General Dynamics Mission Systems (GDMS) has notified us that the DAR-400 will not be able to support or upgrade to changing NSA requirements. SCOPE: To execute the installation and integration of the obsolescence resolution for the mission-critical E-3G DAR-400 to prevent mission impact. The provided Government-owned KG-204 based solution is compliant with current DoD and NSA mandates to replace the legacy DAR-400 equipment. REQUEST FOR INFORMATION DETAILS: 1. AFLCMC/WIW is requesting information from industry as part of market research to determine interest level and size of qualified vendors. 2. THIS IS A SOURCES SOUGHT ONLY. It is not a Request for Proposal, a Request for Quotation, an Invitation for Bid, a solicitation, or an indication the US Air Force (AF) or AFLCMC/WIW will contract for the items contained in the sources sought. AFLCMC/WIW will not pay respondents for information provided in response to the sources sought. 3. The Government is requesting information from vendors of all business sizes including socioeconomic programs such as 8(a), Historically Underutilized Business Zone (HUBZone), Women Owned Small Business, or Service-Disabled Veteran Owned Small Businesses (SDVOSB) that are interested in performing this requirement. The Government requests interested parties submit a brief description of their company�s business size (i.e., annual revenues and employee size), business status (i.e., 8(a), HUBZone, or SDVOSB, Women Owned Small Business, or small business), and any anticipated teaming arrangements. The Government will use this information in determining its small business set-aside decision. 4. Interested parties should submit a capabilities package, with a cover letter, that is brief and concise yet clearly demonstrates ability to meet the stated requirements with sufficiently qualified personnel. Provide qualification information (type and duration of employee experience relevant to the requirements) and the level of involvement (prime or sub-contractor) and time periods for work on similar projects. The capabilities package should clearly present evidence that the interested party is fully capable of providing the required services and as such may contain any information that the interested party feels relevant. 5. Responses should be submitted electronically, and must be no more than ten single-spaced pages, using 12-point, Times New Roman font, and minimum one-inch margins, in Microsoft Word format. Responses that only provide a company website will not be considered. 6. Responses to the sources sought are requested by 3PM, CDT, 30 October 2026. All responses shall be unclassified and reviewed to ensure consideration. All responses, correspondence, and/or questions related to this matter should be e-mailed to: E-mail: phaedra.prather@us.af.mil Phone: (405) 739-4340 Attachments: DAR 400 Follow On SOW_Sep 2026 DAR Follow-On draft CDRL_DID Package 2026

description: SOURCES SOUGHT SYNOPSIS THIS IS A Sources Sought Notice ONLY. The U.S. Government desires to procure the Propane Requirement on a small business set-aside basis, provided 2 or more qualified small businesses respond to this source�s sought synopsis with information sufficient to support a set-aside. Be advised that the U.S. Government will not be able to set aside this requirement if 2 or more small businesses do not respond with information to support the set-aside. We encourage all small businesses, in all socioeconomic categories (including, 8(a) Business Development Program, Small Disadvantaged Business, Historically Underutilized Business Zone, Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business, Economically Disadvantaged Women Owned-Small Business, Women-Owned Small Business concerns), to identify their capabilities in meeting the requirement at a fair market price. This notice is issued solely for information and planning purposes � it does not constitute a Request for Quote (RFQ)/Invitation for Bid (IFB)/Request for Proposal (RFP) or a promise to issue an RFQ, IFB or RFP in the future. This notice does not commit the U.S. Government to contract for any supply or service. Further, the U.S. Government is not seeking quotes, bids or proposals at this time and will not accept unsolicited proposals in response to this source�s sought notice. The U.S. Government will not pay for any information or administrative costs incurred in response to this notice. Submittals will not be returned to the responder. Not responding to this notice does not preclude participation in any future RFQ or IFB or RFP, if any is issued. If a solicitation is released, it will be synopsized on https://sam.gov Point of Entry. It is the responsibility of potential offerors to monitor sam.gov for additional information pertaining to this requirement. The anticipated NAICS code 325120, Industrial Gas Manufacturing, Size Standard 1,200. A continuing need is anticipated for Propane gas to locations around Fort Leonard Wood and Lake of the Ozarks Recreational Area, MO, which is currently being fulfilled through current contract W911S7-25-D-A002. The proposed contract will be for one (1) Base year with four (4) one-year renewable options, resulting in the maximum contract performance period of five (5) years. In response to this source�s sought, please provide: 1. Identify whether your firm is interested in competing for this requirement as a prime contractor or not. 3. Please provide responses to this notice to: faith.a.daniels.civ@army.mil and david.w.foster24.civ@army.mil 4. Telephone responses will not be accepted. Please provide responses in writing, via email no later than 3:00 pm (Central Time), October 30, 2026.

FAILURE ANALYSIS AND CORRECTIVE ACTION:All failure analysis and corrective action reports/plans shall be submitted to the Government. NONCONFORMING MATERIAL:The contractor shall establish an effective system for controlling nonconforming material including procedures for identification, segregation, and disposition. title: USHMM-RFI-2027-MSSP
description: DISCLAIMER / MARKET RESEARCH NOTICE:This Request for Information (RFI) is issued solely for information gathering and planning purposes. It does not constitute a Request for Proposal (RFP), Invitation for Bid (IFB), or an obligation on the part of the United States Holocaust Memorial Museum (USHMM) to acquire any products or services. Responses to this notice are not offers and cannot be accepted by USHMM to form a binding contract. Responders are solely responsible for all expenses associated with responding to this RFI. The United States Holocaust Memorial Museum (USHMM) is conducting formal market research to evaluate commercial vendor capabilities, industry pricing benchmarks, federal/commercial labor rates, and available contract acquisition vehicles (e.g., GSA MAS SIN 54151HACS, NASA SEWP, CIO-SP3/4, SAM.gov) for re-procuring comprehensive Managed Information Technology (IT) Security, Multi-Cloud/DevSecOps Architecture, Network Engineering, and specialized Managed Security Service Provider (MSSP) operational activities. The primary objective of this market research effort is to evaluate whether competitive commercial marketplace capabilities exist to: Sustain, support, and execute day-to-day operations across USHMM's existing "As-Is" securityinfrastructure without operational disruption or increased organizational risk. Perform rigorous security architecture evaluations, threat modeling, gap analyses, and complianceassessments against industry-best security and privacy standards (NIST SP 800-53 r5, FISMA, PCI DSSv4.2.1, CISA Zero Trust Maturity Model, CSF 2.0). Architect and recommend a modernized, cost-effective "To-Be" security state incorporating ZeroTrust architecture, automated orchestration, tool consolidation, and a Government OwnedContractor Operated (GOCO) Security Operations Center (SOC) framework. Execute a seamless, structured transition lifecycle from the "As-Is" state to the "To-Be" operationalmodel within strict schedule and budget parameters. Pricing Benchmarks & Market Rate Expectations Provide feedback on the commercial feasibility of managing this scope under a Firm-Fixed-Price (FFP)monthly fee structure. Provide fully burdened hourly commercial labor rates or GSA schedule rates in the Washington, DCMetropolitan Area for equivalent labor categories (CISO, Security Architect, DevSecOps Engineer,Security Analyst, Network/System Engineer). Submission Instructions & Response Format Response Deadline: All responses shall be submitted electronically no later than October 30, 2026, at 5:00 PM EDT. Submission Format: Responses must be submitted in PDF or Microsoft Word format, strictly limited to no more than fifteen (15) pages (excluding cover page and labor rate tables). Point of Contact: Submissions and any clarifying technical inquiries must be emailed to Mary Green, USHMM Contracting Officer at magreen@ushmm.org with the subject line "RFI Response - USHMM Managed IT Security & MSSP Services".

title: Request for Information on Combat Boot Sock
description: SYNOPSIS: This Sources Sought Announcement is to assist the U.S. Marine Corps Portfolio Acquisition Executive Marine Corps (PAE MC) to identify potential sources to provide a Combat Boot Sock. The goal is to provide warfighting capability and mission support in various environments by enhancing foot comfort, durability, and performance for military personnel. The Government requests that responses be submitted electronically to mary.k.prebensen.civ@army.mil and harvey.walker1@usmc.mil by October 30, 2026 by 5 PM EST. Background: Program Manager Combat Support Systems (PM CSS) is conducting market research to identify potential sources capable of manufacturing a high-performance combat boot sock that meets the requirements of Purchase Description MC-PD-24-003. The sock is intended for use with the applicable standard-issue combat boots identified in the purchase description. This Request for Information (RFI) is issued for market-research and planning purposes only and does not constitute a solicitation, request for proposal, or commitment by the Government to procure any product or service. Description: The Marine Corps is seeking sources capable of manufacturing a durable, reliable combat boot sock designed to provide comfort, protection, and performance during demanding operational use. The sock shall meet the following Salient Characteristics specified in Purchase Description MC-PD-24-003, including, but not limited to, the following key requirements: Sock shall feature an over-the-calf length with cushioning comfort to protect the wearer from hot spots, pressure points, and blisters when wearing combat boots, and they provide graduated compression to promote blood flow from the foot with a non-slip top cuff opening. The foot of each sock includes contouring for the sock to stay in place without bunching, arch support, a gore heel and toe for improved fit, and nylon reinforcement at the heel and toe for durability. A seamless toe closure or a recessed closure with equivalent low profile is used for comfort and durability. Basic Materials. The sock shall contain wool a minimum of 52% wool (no coarser than US 60s (25 microns or finer)), a minimum of 20% nylon, and a minimum of 1% spandex and shall not contain cotton or rayon fiber. Shade. Shall be in accordance with section 3.3 of the Purchase Description Visual shade matching. Shall be in accordance with section 3.4 of the Purchase Description The finished socks shall conform to the requirements specified in table II when tested as specified. **Please refer to Table II. Sock performance requirement** Deliverables: This is a Sources Sought Announcement / RFI to identify potential sources. Based on responses, the Government may plan for a future acquisition. title: TEST SET � ELECTRONIC SEQUENCER
description: SYNOPSIS: #N68335-27-R-1002 TEST SET � ELECTRONIC SEQUENCER Naval Air Warfare Center Aircraft Division - VFC-204 Standup Effort At NOLA The Naval Air Warfare Center, Aircraft Division (NAWCAD) Lakehurst, NJ intends to negotiate on a sole source basis with Teledyne Risi, Inc., CAGE: 0EUB8 for the Test Set � Electronic Sequencer hardware components in support of the NAWCAD VFC-204 Standup Effort At NOLA. This order will procure one (1) Electronic Sequencer Test Set. The Electronic Sequencer Test Set eliminates false removal errors for the Navy Aircrew Common Ejection Seats (NACES) ejection sequencer and allows for true failures. This item is used to expand the test tolerance of the TTU-515/E to account for pressure transducer cyclic drift and update the internal electronics to accommodate the fast sequencer. In addition, six percent of the NACES ejection sequencers are currently being rejected during the SDLM servicing and this item will eliminate those failures. Teledyne Risi, Inc., as the Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) of the Electronic Sequencer Test Set, is the only source with the requisite knowledge, technical experience, and production-level data to produce these components. The components being procured are integral to the NACES ejection sequencer systems and are critical to maintaining operational readiness. The Government intends to solicit and negotiate this requirement under the authority of 10 U.S.C. 2304(c)(1), FAR 6.302-1 - Only one responsible source and no other supplies or services will satisfy agency requirements. THIS NOTICE IS NOT A REQUEST FOR COMPETITIVE PROPOSALS. However, the Government will consider all responses received within fifteen days after the date of publication of this synopsis. Registration in the System for Award Management (SAM) (https://www.sam.gov) is mandatory for consideration. A determination by the Government not to open the requirement to competition based on the responses to this notice will normally be considered solely for the purpose of determining whether to conduct a competitive procurement. Information provided herein is subject to change and in no way binds the Government to solicit for an award of a contract. title: USHMM-RFI-2027-MSSP
description: DISCLAIMER / MARKET RESEARCH NOTICE:This Request for Information (RFI) is issued solely for information gathering and planning purposes. It does not constitute a Request for Proposal (RFP), Invitation for Bid (IFB), or an obligation on the part of the United States Holocaust Memorial Museum (USHMM) to acquire any products or services. Responses to this notice are not offers and cannot be accepted by USHMM to form a binding contract. Responders are solely responsible for all expenses associated with responding to this RFI. The United States Holocaust Memorial Museum (USHMM) is conducting formal market research to evaluate commercial vendor capabilities, industry pricing benchmarks, federal/commercial labor rates, and available contract acquisition vehicles (e.g., GSA MAS SIN 54151HACS, NASA SEWP, CIO-SP3/4, SAM.gov) for re-procuring comprehensive Managed Information Technology (IT) Security, Multi-Cloud/DevSecOps Architecture, Network Engineering, and specialized Managed Security Service Provider (MSSP) operational activities. The primary objective of this market research effort is to evaluate whether competitive commercial marketplace capabilities exist to: Sustain, support, and execute day-to-day operations across USHMM's existing "As-Is" securityinfrastructure without operational disruption or increased organizational risk. Perform rigorous security architecture evaluations, threat modeling, gap analyses, and complianceassessments against industry-best security and privacy standards (NIST SP 800-53 r5, FISMA, PCI DSSv4.2.1, CISA Zero Trust Maturity Model, CSF 2.0). Architect and recommend a modernized, cost-effective "To-Be" security state incorporating ZeroTrust architecture, automated orchestration, tool consolidation, and a Government OwnedContractor Operated (GOCO) Security Operations Center (SOC) framework. Execute a seamless, structured transition lifecycle from the "As-Is" state to the "To-Be" operationalmodel within strict schedule and budget parameters. Pricing Benchmarks & Market Rate Expectations Provide feedback on the commercial feasibility of managing this scope under a Firm-Fixed-Price (FFP)monthly fee structure. Provide fully burdened hourly commercial labor rates or GSA schedule rates in the Washington, DCMetropolitan Area for equivalent labor categories (CISO, Security Architect, DevSecOps Engineer,Security Analyst, Network/System Engineer). Submission Instructions & Response Format Response Deadline: All responses shall be submitted electronically no later than October 30, 2026, at 5:00 PM EDT. Submission Format: Responses must be submitted in PDF or Microsoft Word format, strictly limited to no more than fifteen (15) pages (excluding cover page and labor rate tables). Point of Contact: Submissions and any clarifying technical inquiries must be emailed to Mary Green, USHMM Contracting Officer at magreen@ushmm.org with the subject line "RFI Response - USHMM Managed IT Security & MSSP Services".

title: S207--Integrated Pest Management Services
USAF Special Operations Forces Technical Data Management, Development, and Provisioning Project
description: The Government is conducting market research to identify capable small-business sources with the expertise, capabilities, and relevant experience to provide technical manual development and revision, technical data management, configuration management support, engineering support services, and AC-130J-only provisioning support for Special Operations Forces (SOF) C-130 aircraft (AC, MC, and HC). AC-130J provisioning support includes; identification and recommendation of spare, repairable, and consumable material requirements; and support for provisioning conferences and Government-approved Source, Maintenance, and Recoverability (SMR) code recommendations. The Government is considering an acquisition strategy consisting of a five-year technical data contract, including one 12-month base period and four 12-month option periods. The contractor would provide technical writing and technical data development support for incorporation into subsequent Technical Order (TO) revisions and updates. The contractor would provide configuration management support, including the policies, procedures, techniques, and tools necessary to: � Evaluate proposed changes; � Maintain configuration status accounting; � Track and document changes; and � Incorporate approved changes into TOs in accordance with applicable requirements. The contractor would provide engineering services, as required, to review, compile, and develop authorized source data into technical data suitable for Government review and approval. The contractor would provide AC-130J-only provisioning support to identify and recommend spare, repairable, and consumable material requirements necessary to support system operation and sustainment; recommendation of SMR codes for Government approval, and participation in AC-130J provisioning and configuration guidance conferences. The contractor would furnish all material, support equipment, tools, and services necessary to perform the required technical data development, technical manual revision, configuration management, and engineering support services, except for items expressly identified as Government-furnished. The contractor would be responsible for providing, utilizing and maintaining, all support equipment and/or software required at their facility or a subcontractor�s facility. The Government currently possesses a specification-control drawing for certain components within the anticipated requirement. The drawing is not a manufacturing (�build-to�) drawing. Lockheed Martin possesses the complete technical data package for the applicable part(s), and the Government does not currently have authority to release, purchase, or provide access to the complete package. Respondents are advised that participation in this market research effort does not guarantee participation in any future solicitation or contract award. The Government will not reimburse respondents for costs incurred in preparing or submitting responses to this RFI.

description: Το αντικείμενο της δημόσιας σύμβασης αφορά την κατασκευή κτιριακών υποδομών και τη διαμόρφωση του περιβάλλοντος χώρου του Εκπαιδευτικού Αστρονομικού Πάρκου Όρλιακα (ΕΑΠΟ). Ο τόπος εκτέλεσης του έργου είναι γήπεδο έκτασης 28 στρεμμάτων, στο 6ο χιλιόμετρο της επαρχιακής οδού Ζιάκα–Περιβολίου, σε ύψωμα «Ράχη Κερασιάς» της οροσειράς Όρλιακα, στην περιοχή Γρεβενών, σε υψόμετρο περίπου 1.450 μέτρων.Το έργο περιλαμβάνει την ανέγερση κτιριακού συγκροτήματος αποτελούμενου από έξι κτίρια, τα οποία θα εξυπηρετούν τις λειτουργικές ανάγκες του Πάρκου, καθώς και την κατασκευή δεξαμενής ύδρευσης, συστήματος αποχέτευσης με διάταξη βόθρων, περίφραξης και διαμόρφωσης του περιβάλλοντος χώρου, συμπεριλαμβανομένων χώρων στάθμευσης.Οι απαιτούμενες οικοδομικές και ηλεκτρομηχανολογικές εργασίες περιγράφονται αναλυτικά στα τεύχη της διακήρυξης.

title: Bulgaria – Security-type printed matter – „Изработка и доставка на холограмни стикери“ по обособена позиция № 2 „Изработка и доставка на комплект „Знак и стикер за първоначален технически преглед на МПС“
description: Предметът на обществената поръчка включва изработка и доставка на холограмни стикери по обособени позиции, в частта по Обособена позиция 2 „Изработка и доставка на комплект „Знак и стикер за първоначален технически преглед на МПС“ - 2 000 000 бр. холографски стикера и 2 000 000 бр. знак със съответните холограмни реквизити. ​На основание чл. 21, ал. 6 от ЗОП, във връзка с чл. 7 от ППЗОП, обособена позиция № 1 с предмет: „Изработка и доставка на холограмни стикери за служебните карти на служителите на МВР" - 60 000 бр., ще се възлага чрез директно възлагане, по реда на чл. 21​, ал. 6 от ЗОП, съобразно прогнозната й стойност от 75 180,00 евро без ДДС. Стойността на обособена позиция № 1 не надхвърля стойността от 79 998,77 евро без ДДС и 20 на сто от общата прогнозна стойност на поръчката, която е 5 995 180,00 евро без ДДС. Съгласно разпоредба на чл. 7, ал. 1 от ППЗОП, остатъчната стойност на поръчката е 5 920 000,00 евро без ДДС. В изпълнение на чл. 21, ал. 6 от ЗОП, независимо от размера на остатъчната стойност на поръчката, тя се възлага по реда, приложим към общата прогнозна стойност на цялата поръчка. ​​​​​​​В настоящата обществена поръчка оферта се подава САМО по обособена позиция № 2 „Изработка и доставка на комплект „Знак и стикер за първоначален технически преглед на МПС“. ​​​​​​​Обособена позиция № 1 ще се възлага по реда на чл. 21, ал. 6 от ЗОП.

title: France – Processing and clearing services – Fourniture de chèques emploi service universels (CESU), dématérialisés ou non, aux agents des ministères sociaux.
description: Dans le cadre de la politique conduite pour favoriser les services à la personne – Plan de développement des services à la personne LOI N° 2005-841 du 26 juillet 2005, les ministères sociaux ont mis en place, depuis septembre 2006 le chèque emploi service universel (CESU) préfinancé pour une partie de leurs agents, destinés notamment au paiement : • Du salaire net d'un salarié employé directement dans le cadre des services à la personne ; • De prestations de services à la personne fournies par des organismes agréés ; • Des structures d'accueil de jeunes enfants (crèches, garderies, centres de loisirs…) ; • De structures agréées, habilitées à effectuer, pour le compte de particuliers employeurs, l'ensemble des formalités liées à l'emploi d'un salarié à domicile (recrutement, gestion administrative du salarié, ...) ; • De prestations d'aide à domicile délivrées à ses ascendants par des salariés employés à domicile ou des organismes agréés, si ces ascendants sont bénéficiaires de l'allocation personnalisée d'autonomie (APA). Le CESU est un titre de paiement nominatif à montant prédéfini délivré par les ministères sociaux qui en assurent le financement intégral.

title: Greece – Plumbing materials – ΠΡΟΜΗΘΕΙΑ ΥΔΡΑΥΛΙΚΩΝ ΥΛΙΚΩΝ 2027-2030
description: Αντικείμενο της σύμβασης είναι η προμήθεια υδραυλικών υλικών, τα οποία θα χρησιμοποιηθούν από τις υπηρεσίες του Δήμου την τετραετία 2027, 2028, 2029 και 2030, ήτοι μέχρι 31/12/2030 ή έως την εξάντληση του ποσού και των ποσοτήτων, εφόσον η προμήθεια εκτελεστεί σε ποσοστό 100%. Η δαπάνη για την παρούσα προμήθεια προϋπολογίζεται να ανέλθει στις 1.189.281,57€, συμπεριλαμβανομένου ΦΠΑ (Προϋπολογισμός χωρίς ΦΠΑ 959.098,04€ + ΦΠΑ 24% 230.183,53€ = 1.189.281,57€) και θα καλυφθεί από τον προϋπολογισμό των οικονομικών ετών 2027, 2028, 2029 και 2030 του Δήμου Φυλής ως πολυετής δαπάνη (Ποσό απορρόφησης ανά έτος 2027, 2028, 2029 και 2030 = 297.320,39€). Η παρούσα δαπάνη θα βαρύνει τον Α.Λ.Ε. 025.2410106001. Οι τιμές μονάδας για κάθε είδος που αναγράφονται στον ενδεικτικό προϋπολογισμό της παρούσας μελέτης, εκτιμήθηκαν με βάση την έρευνα αγοράς από το ελεύθερο εμπόριο και λαμβάνοντας υπόψιν και σχετικούς διαγωνισμούς που έχει διεξάγει ο δήμος τα προηγούμενα έτη. Η αναγκαιότητα της εν λόγω σύμβασης προκύπτει από τις αυξημένες ανάγκες των υπηρεσιών του δήμου για την ως άνω προμήθεια, μετά και την κατάργηση των νομικών προσώπων των Ο.Τ.Α. (Νόμος 5056/2023, ΦΕΚ Α 163/6.10.2023). Οι ποσότητες της προηγούμενης υπογραφείσας σχετικής σύμβασης για τα έτη 2025-2026 έχουν σχεδόν εξαντληθεί ήδη με αποτέλεσμα την άμεση ολοκλήρωση της σύμβασης αυτής. Έτσι δημιουργήθηκε η αναγκαιότητα πρόσθετων ποσοτήτων για τα έτη 2027, 2028, 2029 και 2030 που αναμένεται να καλυφθεί με την εν λόγω διαδικασία. Οι ποσότητες των υδραυλικών υλικών που αναφέρονται στον Πίνακα Ενδεικτικού Προϋπολογισμού της παρούσας μελέτης είναι αμιγώς ενδεικτικές και όχι δεσμευτικές για την αναθέτουσα αρχή. Η εκτέλεση της προμήθειας και η ανάλωση των ειδών θα πραγματοποιούνται τμηματικά, ανάλογα με τις πραγματικές ανάγκες και κατόπιν παραγγελιών των αρμόδιων υπηρεσιών του Δήμου Φυλής, οι οποίες θα εξαρτώνται από τις εκάστοτε παρουσιαζόμενες ανάγκες συντήρησης και αποκατάστασης των δικτύων. Ο Δήμος Φυλής διατηρεί το δικαίωμα να μην εξαντλήσει το σύνολο των ενδεικτικών ποσοτήτων ή του προϋπολογισμού κατά τη διάρκεια της τετραετούς σύμβασης. Οι τελικές ποσότητες των υλικών που θα παραγγελθούν ενδέχεται να είναι μικρότερες των προϋπολογισθέντων, ανάλογα με τις πραγματικές ανάγκες των αρμόδιων υπηρεσιών. Ο ανάδοχος δεν διατηρεί καμία αξίωση για αποζημίωση ή διαφυγόντα κέρδη σε περίπτωση που η απορρόφηση υπολείπεται του αρχικού ενδεικτικού προϋπολογισμού. Η προμήθεια κατατάσσεται στους Κωδικούς Κοινού Λεξιλογίου δημοσίων συμβάσεων (CPV): 44115210-4 Υλικά υδραυλικών εγκαταστάσεων Η εκτέλεση της παραπάνω προμήθειας θα γίνει με την διενέργεια δημόσιου ηλεκτρονικού διαγωνισμού άνω των ορίων και με κριτήριο κατακύρωσης την πλέον συμφέρουσα από οικονομική άποψη προσφοράς, βάσει τιμής σύμφωνα με τις διατάξεις του Ν.4412/2016 όπως τροποποιήθηκαν και ισχύουν, για το σύνολο των προς προμήθεια ειδών. Η παρούσα προμήθεια δεν υποδιαιρείται σε τμήματα. Προσφορές υποβάλλονται για το σύνολο των παραπάνω ειδών. Η διάρκεια υλοποίησης της προμήθειας ορίζεται από την υπογραφή της σύμβασης για την τετραετία 2027, 2028, 2029 και 2030, ήτοι μέχρι 31/12/2030 ή έως την εξάντληση του ποσού και των ποσοτήτων,εφόσον η προμήθεια εκτελεστεί σε ποσοστό 100%. Αναλυτική περιγραφή του φυσικού και οικονομικού αντικειμένου της σύμβασης δίδεται στην υπ’ αριθμ. 160/2026 μελέτη της υπηρεσίας. Η σύμβαση μπορεί να τροποποιείται κατά τη διάρκειά της, χωρίς να απαιτείται νέα διαδικασία σύναψης σύμβασης, μόνο σύμφωνα με τους όρους και τις προϋποθέσεις του άρθρου 132 του ν. 4412/2016 και κατόπιν γνωμοδότησης της καθ’ ύλην αρμόδιας υπηρεσίας ή άλλως της υπηρεσίας η οποία ορίζεται με απόφαση της Α.Α. Η σύμβαση θα ανατεθεί με το κριτήριο της πλέον συμφέρουσας από οικονομική άποψη προσφοράς, βάσει της τιμής.

title: IT kehittämisen ja ylläpidon palvelut ajalle 1.11.2022 (tavoite) - 31.10.2026
description: Tämän dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän (DPS) kohteena on IT kehittämisen ja ylläpidon palvelut Turun kaupungin asiakkaille. DPS:n kohde on kuvattu tarkemmin osallistumispyynnössä ja sen liitteissä, erityisesti liitteessä "Dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän kohde". Tilaaja täsmentää ja kuvaa hankintatarpeensa tarkemmin dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän sisäisen kilpailutuksen tarjouspyynnöissään. DPS:ään voi jättää osallistumishakemuksia koko sen keston ajan. Kaikki hakijoille asetetut soveltuvuusvaatimukset täyttävät hakijat hyväksytään osallistumaan DPS:ssään. Hankinnat tehdään DPS:n sisällä erillisillä tarjouspyynnöillä. DPS:n kohteena on IT-asiantuntijatyö. Dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän kohteeseen kuuluvat seuraavat palvelut: 1) IT kehittämisen ja ylläpidon palvelut sekä lisenssit 2) IT-omaisuuden hallinta 3) Tietoturva ja tietosuoja 4) Määrittely ja jatkuvuussuunnittelu 5) Sovellus- ja ohjelmistokehitys ja ylläpito 6) Alustapalvelut ja lisenssit 7) Toteutuksen arkkitehtuuri DPS:n keston aikana kaikki kiinnostuneet ehdokkaat voivat tehdä siihen osallistumishakemuksen. Turun kaupungin asiantuntijat toteuttavat hankinnat DPS:ään hyväksyttyjen ehdokkaiden kesken DPS:n sisäisillä kilpailutuksilla, jotka voivat ajoittua DPS:n koko hankintavaiheen ajalle. DPS:n hankintavaihe alkaa perustamisvaiheen jälkeen arviolta 15.11.2022 ja päättyy DPS:n voimassaoloajan päättyessä.

Le secrétariat soutient le comité ainsi que les autres organes de l’USSP dans l’accomplissement de leurs tâches et assure un fonctionnement professionnel, continu et efficace.


Le mandat comprend notamment le soutien spécialisé et la représentation des intérêts, le soutien organisationnel et administratif du comité et des organes de l’association, la communication interne et externe, les finances et la comptabilité, l’administration générale ainsi que l’organisation et la coordination de manifestations, de groupes de travail et d’autres organes.


Il comprend notamment la participation à des projets et au traitement de questions spécialisées, la préparation de bases de décision et de séances, la gestion du site Internet et d’autres canaux de communication, la tenue de la comptabilité et de l’administration des membres ainsi que l’accompagnement organisationnel de manifestations et de parties prenantes externes. title: Kantonsstrasse Nr. 55, Nesslau: Sanierung Brücke Luteren, Ennetbühl
description:
Les travaux en question concernent des prestations d'ingénierie pour la remise en état et le renforcement statique d'un pont en arc en béton damé classé, doté d'un tablier en béton coulé sur place. D'autres prestations doivent être fournies dans le domaine de la rénovation et de la rectification de la chaussée. Le marché porte sur les phases de prestations SIA 31 à 53.

La conception du projet repose sur la recommandation de mesures. Outre les renforcements statiques des arches et de la chaussée, il convient de renouveler les dalles en porte-à-faux et de remettre en état les surfaces en béton. De plus, le tracé horizontal doit être optimisé sur une longueur d’environ 400 m. Dans ce contexte, deux nouveaux murs de soutènement doivent être construits. La durée des travaux doit être réduite au minimum et le déroulement du chantier optimisé tout en maintenant la circulation sur une seule voie.

title: Udbud vedrørende anskaffelse af mobilt opdæmningsmateriel
description: Udbud vedrørende anskaffelse af mobilt opdæmningsmateriel Beskrivelse (dansk): Beredskabsstyrelsen ("BRS") ønsker sammen med landets 30 kommunale redningsberedskaber ("de Kommunale Beredskaber") at indgå en rammeaftale om anskaffelse af mobilt dæmningsmateriel i form af fritstående oversvømmelsesbarrierer. Anskaffelsen har primært til formål at understøtte BRS' og de Kommunale Beredskabers akutte håndtering af klimahændelser, herunder ved varsling om forhøjet vandstand fra bagland såvel som havvand, samt ved indsats i forbindelse med større brande. Det mobile dæmningsmateriel skal anvendes både selvstændigt i forbindelse med håndteringen af bl.a. klimahændelser, ligesom det skal indgå som supplement til BRS' og de Kommunale Beredskabers eksisterende opdæmningsmateriel. Materiellet skal kunne anvendes i flere forskellige indsatsscenarier. Det skal for det første kunne etableres hurtigt og fleksibelt over varierende strækninger ved ekstraordinære vandstandsstigninger, herunder ved akut indsats i baglandet, f.eks. ved søer og åer, samt ved kyster og havne. Det skal for det andet kunne benyttes til beskyttelse af enkeltobjekter, f.eks. kritisk infrastruktur. Det skal for det tredje kunne anvendes som vandreservoir i forbindelse med større brandindsatser, hvor vand anbringes i reservoiret, hvorfra én eller flere pumper fordeler vandet til indsatsområdet. Det mobile dæmningsmateriel skal have en primær højde svarende til højden på BRS' eksisterende og mest anvendte opdæmningsmateriel. Da de lokale beredskabers risikovurderinger og behov varierer, ønskes der herudover tilbudt opdæmningsmateriel i andre højder, som muliggør tilpasning til områder med behov for lavere eller højere opdæmning. Det er væsentligt, at materiellet tillader hurtig, let og effektiv transport, etablering og nedtagning, herunder at håndteringen kan ske med et minimum af ressourcer og på en arbejdsmiljømæssigt forsvarlig måde. Materiellet forudsættes at kunne benyttes flere gange. Materiellet vil blive oplagret på lager og transporteret til indsatsområderne via lastbil. Under indsættelse skal materiellet kunne håndteres ved håndkraft, herunder aflæsses, opsættes, nedtages og læsses, af et minimalt mandskab. Rammeaftalen har en varighed af 4 år fra underskrift.

title: Omsetning av fysiske kraftrettigheter og rådgivning og bistand til finansiell sikring
description: 1.1 Om oppdragsgiveren Ål Kraftverk KF innbyr til konkurranse om salg og optimering av kraftrettigheter, samt rådgivning og bistand til finansiell sikring. Ål Kraftverk KF er et heleid kommunalt foretak som er eid av Ål kommune. Foretaket ble opprettet i 1914 og forvalter de kommunale kraftrettighetene for Ål kommune, samt drifter Ylifossen kraftverk. De kommunale kraftrettighetene består av ca. 101 GWh konsesjonskraft, 80 GWh erstatningskraft og andelskraft fra Usta og Nes Kraftverk på 45-65 GWh. Kraftverket har også produksjon fra Ylifossen kraftverk på ca. 12. GWh. (I tillegg har Ål Kraftverk en andel i Lya kraftverk på 30 prosent som utgjør ca. 5. GWh, men denne er ikke omfattet av oppdraget.) Til sammen utgjør dette rettigheter og produksjon for Ål Kraftverk på ca. 245 GWh. 1.2 Omfanget av oppdraget Formålet med denne anskaffelsen er å inngå avtale om rådgivning og forvaltning av Ål Kraftverk KFs kraftrettigheter. Oppdraget omfatter å melde om uttak av kraft og selge kraften på Nord Pool til best mulige priser (optimering av brukstidsverdien i konsesjonskraften), rådgivning og bistand ved finansiell sikring av deler av kraftrettighetene. Oppdraget er nærmere spesifisert i punkt 2 nedenfor. Tilbudet er lagt ut ved elektronisk konkurransegjennomføring (KGV) og følger anskaffelsesforskriften del 2. 1.3 Kontraktens varighet og volum Kontraktenes varighet er 5 år. Oppstartsdato er 1. januar 2027. De samlede kraftrettighetene som omfattes av kontrakten er ca. 245 GWh per år. Kontrakten reguleres av kontraktsvilkårene som er vedlagt konkurransegrunnlaget og spesifikasjonene som kommer frem i konkurransegrunnlaget og i leverandørens tilbud. 2. Om leveransen Ål Kraftverk KF har følgende fysiske rettigheter som er omfattet av oppdraget Konsesjonskraft ca. 101 GWh Ylifossen kraftverk ca. 12 GWh Nes og Usta kraftverk: Erstatningskraft 80 GWh Nes og Usta kraftverk: Andelskraft 45–65 GWh Leveransen omfatter følgende elementer: a) Anmelding av konsesjonskraft og salg av andre kraftrettigheter. på Nord Pool. b) Rådgivning og bistand i forbindelse med finansiell sikring. Sikringen skjer bilateralt med finansinstitusjon som motpart. c) Månedlige rapporter som viser uttaket de enkelte timer og inntekter for det fysiske salget, og en oppstilling med oversikt over inntekter d) Oppgjør og fakturering Det er et overordnet krav til leveransen at den skal være transparent for Ål Kraftverk. Leverandøren skal i tilbudet beskrive gebyrstruktur, netting-effekter på Nord Pool og eventuelt andre økonomiske fordeler som kraftforvalter oppnår ved å få kraftvolumet til Ål Kraftverk i sin portefølje på Nord Pool. NB! Se også vedlagte konkurransegrunnlag

Det er kun de prækvalificerede ansøgere, der på Ordregivers opfordring kan afgive tilbud. description: Bei den vorliegenden Arbeiten handelt es sich um Ingenieurdienstleistungen für die Instandsetzung und statische Verstärkung einer unter Schutz stehenden Stampfbetonbogenbrücke mit Ortbetonfahrbahnplatte. Weitere Leistungen sind im Bereich der Strassensanierung und Strassenkorrektion zu erbringen. Der Auftrag umfasst die Bearbeitung der SIA-Leistungsphasen 31 bis 53. Grundlage für die Projektierung bildet die Massnahmenempfehlung. Neben den statischen Verstärkungen der Bögen und der Fahrbahnplatte sind die Kragplatten zu erneuern und die Betonoberflächen instand zu stellen. Zudem ist die horizontale Linienführung auf einer Länge von rund 400 Meter zu optimieren. In diesem Zusammenhang sind zwei neue Stützmauern zu erstellen. Die Bauzeit soll möglichst kurz gehalten und der Bauvorgang unter Aufrechterhaltung einer halbseitigen Verkehrsführung optimiert werden.
